method: User JWST 20 FITS starmask -> 0.6arcsec Lambert equal-area clipped-sum union raster -> iid weighted mask-cell centers (1000 draws) -> full exact CAOM polygon point membership for 717 PUBLIC red NIRCam image records with >=365d disjoint observation time intervals. Independent implementation in JS, with Python reproduction committed.

provenance.sample_encoding: 5-character base64url for each pair (x_cell_index << 14)|y_cell_index, 0.6arcsec Lambert grid origin -0.7 deg, width 1.4 deg

WHT_star_mask_conditional_set_bounds.nesting_assumption: WHT>0 grid area and WHT red subset are within exact archival F444W survey and red polygons respectively, as in wht_depth_mask.evaluate()

independent_geometry_validation.note: Checks independent JS polygon parsing, Lambert inverse and epoch pair membership; not a substitute for native WHT raster or exact JWST-mask union.

limitations: This is a 1000-sample weighted Monte Carlo intersection, not exact masked-pixel/polygon intersection. Red-area sampling 95% half-width is ~0.00040 deg²; raster and WCS systematics are additional.
0.6arcsec mask union raster upper vs lower approximation differs by ~0.00021 deg²; 0.3arcsec union spans 0.0127956-0.0128986 deg².
WHT 60mas occupancy grid was not saved in the prior run, so no exact WHT∩star-mask area is available without its spatial cells. The 59.28-59.76% bound is conditional on nesting and MC estimates.
The ~0.96% WHT deposition clipping bias persists; do not claim subpercent physical-area accuracy.
Mask code 1 interpreted as excluded, pending explicit official semantics confirmation.
Not F444W=26.2 AB dropout selection, no blue-band local noise, no source flags/segmentation, no F356W SNR, no PM astrometric completeness.
